findings.title: Lapsed holds release their units before they are expired, so stock is promised twice
findings.trigger: A hold passes expires_at; before the worker runs, another client reserves the freed units, and the first client then confirms its old hold.
findings.impact: reserved_in_bin stops counting the lapsed hold while it is still HELD, so its units go to the new hold, and the late confirm turns the same units into a confirmed order, overselling the bin.
